Imgur was made for Reddit by a Reddit user, Veuwer was made for Voat by a Voat user. That's pretty much it at the moment. It's a file hosting site made by a FPH user because they wanted to move away from imgur. If you want to use a different site there's always veuwer.com that was made by a Voat user

Imgur started censoring the images posted to it's site. It started with the FPH images, so FPH made their own "Slimgur" page.

Just a few days after Imgur started censoring it's content, Reddit brought down the banhammer and banned FPH; so we all moved to Voat. Considering most of us were already using Slimgur for FPH the last few days before the ban, we just continued the practice here.

Even for non FPH posts none of us want to support censorship, so we refuse to use both Reddit and Imgur.
